ogun OS · SDK & API · build custom apps
Build apps that run natively in ogun OS. Apps are packaged as manifests, versioned, color-coded, and can be deployed to any ogun instance or listed in the ogun App Store.
// ogun App Manifest · app.manifest.json { "id": "com.myorg.myapp", "name": "myapp", "version": "0.1.0", "color": "#6088d8", "icon": "M", "tags": ["custom", "productivity"], "description": "My custom ogun OS app", "entrypoint": "main.js", "permissions": ["kogi.read", "enzo.read"] }
